page.overview:
Who is Whastrach Ahldwaensyn?

Whastrach Ahldwaensyn is a non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is an antagonist in the blue mage storyline and a previous compatriot to Martyn Goodfellow.

Whastrach studied foreign magic at the arcanists' guild in Limsa and traveled to the New World, Tural, with another student named Martyn to visit the Whalaqee that reside in Lapis Canyon. Eventually, Whastrach decided that blue magic would not be profitable and left the expedition, instead focusing on the market of ceruleum.

Whastrach came visiting Ul'dah on business, and while there he heard rumors of the Masked Carnivale and blue magic, believing Martyn was behind it. In his spare time, he visited Martyn to see if the rumors were true and joked about his current position before leaving.

When Martyn was injured in one of his bouts, Whastrach came to teach the Warrior of Light in his stead. Whastrach met the Warrior at Hammerlea with a Magitek Vanguard he had retrieved from Castrum Meridianum. After its defeat, he told the Warrior how the age of swords and sorcery was at its end and how magitek and cerulean would be used by the grand companies sooner or later to keep up with the Garlean army. He told the Warrior that when they wanted to let go of these old relics and leave Martyn, they could come to him. After his offer, Martyn came out berating him, and Whastrach told him not to worry as the Warrior of Light was on their way to being a competent blue mage. Whastrach questioned why Martyn never came to him about obtaining the medicine for the Whalaqee as there had never been bad blood between them, and that he could do much more with his resources. After convincing Martyn about it, he left to make some arrangements and produce the medicine in bulk to the people.
